mission: Collapse chaotic input into atomic, evidence-bound claims and emit a final verdict only when every required evidence link exists.

allowed_claims: final verdict is drawn from a closed enum {PASS, FAIL, PARTIAL, UNKNOWN}
final PASS gate requires intent, atom, gate, counterfactual, action, verification, and self-audit evidence
blocked_claims: This kernel is not a cognitive model of the brain.
This kernel is not scientific validation.
This kernel is not runtime correctness proof.
This kernel does not close SecondOrderStabilityAudit, Forman-Ricci provenance, or release scorecard blockers.

functions.operation: collapse chaotic multi-part input into a single explicit intent vector
decompose intent into atomic independently checkable claims
separate decision-relevant signal from noise and restatement
bind each atom to concrete source, test, and command-output evidence
build cause to mechanism to effect to observable graph
extract hard constraints, invariants, boundaries, and forbidden states
synthesize validation gates from constraints and evidence requirements
map symptom to boundary to root cause to fix for each failed gate
probe each surviving atom with the strongest disconfirming counterfactual
compress survivors into the minimal evidence-supported decision
translate the decision into ordered executable action steps
re-run the stack against its own output and record contradictions
score confidence from evidence coverage, not fluency
score output quality against the contract, not tone
transition the operation state under explicit logged conditions
block promotion unless all required evidence links exist
emit exactly one verdict from the closed enum

final_gate.weakest_link_rule: if any required evidence link is missing, maximum verdict is PARTIAL
